title: (Japanese) Mankey 056/165 C sv2a 151 Pokéball Reverse Holo - Pokémon TCG
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Japanese Mankey card is a must-have for any Pokémon TCG collector! With a card number of 056/165 and a rarity of Common, this Stage 1 Fighting-type Pokémon card is made of high-quality card stock and features a Reverse Holo finish. The card is in standard size and was manufactured by Nintendo in 2023. 

The card features the character Mankey and is illustrated by Mina Nakai. It is suitable for ages 4+ and is part of the 151 set. This card is a great addition to any collection and is sure to impress any Pokémon fan!
